q: We often feed her to sleep and she’ll sleep about 10-11 hours a night. If it’s working well for us, do we really need to stop this? My husband says if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Thoughts?

q: The baby sleep industry is so overwhelming!

q: Step 1. Get lucky with an easy, good sleeper! But in all seriousness, I truly think we just got lucky. I will say, we really don't follow a strict bedtime routine like I've seen others do so again, I think it's just temperament.

q: People are doing full 30 minute routines AFTER feeding baby. And I’m sure it is helpful but just hard to wrap my head around playing with a baby that’s already sleepy for 30 minutes to essentially “wake her up” and put her in her crib that way.

q: We’re doing almost exclusively bottle feeding pumped milk so I can share the responsibility.

q: Daycare naps are truly ruining my life! Like I am stalking the daycare app like it's my favorite social media!
